user.title: Emaldo local takeover
user.description: Point the Emaldo integration at your self-hosted takeover API. Enter the HTTPS host of your takeover server (e.g. {example}). The Emaldo cloud integration must already be configured. If the takeover API is served with a private CA, paste that CA certificate (e.g. from {ca}); Home Assistant's client does not read the system trust store, so without it every call fails certificate verification.

error.not_a_certificate: That does not look like a PEM certificate (it must contain BEGIN CERTIFICATE).
